brief:
Israeli journalist Rubik Rosenthal wrote in the Hebrew newspaper Haaretz on Sunday that Hamas's former political bureau chief Yahya Sinwar defeated Israeli society, according to Shehab Wire. Rosenthal's article suggested Sinwar achieved a significant psychological or strategic victory over the Israeli public even as his military campaign ultimately failed.

The commentary reflects ongoing Israeli debate about the war's broader consequences beyond conventional military measures, with some analysts assessing lasting damage to Israeli morale and social cohesion.

title: Israeli writer claims Sinwar defeated Israeli society despite military loss
